The Chartered Financial Analysts (CFA) Dinner: Centum is dedicated to developing professionals in the Kenyan investment industry. We
therefore partnered with the CFA Kenya through their graduation dinner to celebrate professionals who had successfully completed the coveted
CFA qualification. Centum has four Chartered Financial Analysts and several others still seeking the qualification.
